+"""Vision-guided one-episode controller for closing the microwave door.
+
+Uses only the service's RGB/depth camera observations, calibration, and robot
+proprioception. Actions are sent in short chunks so each contact can be checked.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAM = ['robot0_agentview_center', 'robot0_agentview_right', 'robot0_eye_in_hand']
+
+
+def action(dx=0., dy=0., dz=0., rx=0., ry=0., rz=0., grip=-1.,
+           base_x=0., base_y=0., base_yaw=0., torso=0., mode=-1.):
+    """One ee_delta step; translations are 5 cm per unit, rotations 0.5 rad."""
+    return np.array([dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz, grip, base_x, base_y,
+                     base_yaw, torso, mode], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+def run():
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    print('protocol', spec['protocol'], 'control_dt', spec['control_dt'])
+    print('time_left_s', robot.status().get('time_left_s'))
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAM, include_depth=True, video='none')
+    obs.save(str(OUT / 'stage_0'))
+    print('initial', obs.meta['proprio']['now'][25:29], obs.meta['time_left_s'])
+
+    # Approach the observed microwave handle by 1 cm in robot-base -y.
+    move = action(dy=-0.20)
+    res = robot.submit('ee_delta', move[None, :], dt=spec['control_dt'],
+                       interpolate='hold', cameras=CAM, video='none', include_depth=True,
+                       note='small visual-servo approach toward microwave handle')
+    res.save(str(OUT / 'stage_1'))
+    print('after approach', res.meta['proprio']['now'][25:29], res.meta['time_left_s'])
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    run()
*** End Patch";
